sloka: न्यवेदयत च आत्मानम् तस्मै लक्ष्मण पूर्वजः ।पुत्रौ दशरथस्य आवाम् भगवन् राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥२-५४-१३॥
transliteration: nyavedayata ca ātmānam tasmai lakṣmaṇa pūrvajaḥ ।putrau daśarathasya āvām bhagavan rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥2-54-13॥

translations.english: Lakshmana's elder brother (Rama) introduced himself (to Bharadwaja), O venerable one, we are both sons of Dasaratha, Rama and Lakshmana.
